provenance.note: A0 modern-regime re-validation. Generated by drivers/mvnmle/{fp32_gate,hard_cases,compare_r_reproduce}.py against a PyPI-installed pystatistics==4.6.13, on TWO hosts: CPU+MPS on the Mac (throwaway PyPI venv), CPU+CUDA on Forge (RTX 5070 Ti, cloned gpumice env, standing CUDA-testing allowance). 4.6.13 is the patch that fixes finding M1 (constant-column fail-loud) surfaced during this pass; the fp32 numeric paths are byte-unchanged from 4.6.12 so the gate/CPU-vs-R numbers reproduce, while the hard-case grid now shows the constant column failing loud. Supersedes the pre-red-team v3.18.0 report.

reference.name: R mvnmle
reference.what: Maximum-likelihood estimation of mean and covariance for incomplete multivariate-normal data.

studies.title: CPU vs R head-to-head (GSS/WVS, standardized, p = 15,20,25)
studies.note: pystatistics CPU (fp64) re-measured fresh at 4.6.13; R mvnmle reference at p=15 both surveys re-confirms curation parity (loglik matches the v3.18.0 frozen value bit-for-bit). p=20/25 R reference carried from v3.18.0 (R is version-independent). CPU matches R to fp64 round-off and runs ~90-320x faster.

studies.title: fp32 GPU no-silent-wrong gate proof (CUDA, authoritative)
studies.note: R12/R13 true-classifier proof. For each problem the fp32 GPU fit and the fp64 reference are both re-scored under one fp64 evaluator: deficit = fp64-optimum minus fp32-fit-rescored-in-fp64 (the true optimization gap), sigma_rel_fro = covariance error, ref_gate/gpu_gate = the default accept/refuse decision. Synthetic sweep dials the condition number; survey rows are the standardized GSS/WVS regime the audit flagged. Everywhere gpu_gate accepts, the fp32 fit is at the fp32 floor; at the boundary gpu_gate refuses (fp32 accept-set subset of fp64) -- never the dangerous direction.

studies.title: fp32 GPU gate proof (MPS, secondary)
studies.note: MPS confirmation of the CUDA gate proof (MPS is second-class; CUDA is authoritative). Same true-classifier behavior; WVS fp32 error near machine-fp32, GSS a few percent, gates safe-side.

studies.title: R10 adversarial hard-case grid + R15 default invocation
studies.note: The naive default mlest(X) on each adversarial design vs R mvnmle. default_clean and heavy_missing match R to fp64 round-off; near/exact-collinear FAIL LOUD (SingularMatrixError) where R silently returns a fit on a rank-deficient problem; constant_column now FAILS LOUD at 4.6.13 (was silently converged=True at 4.6.12 -- finding M1).
